text: Foundation F1-F5 (foundation.md D1-D6) built in this epic first: the any-mcp orchestrator plugin, the wrapper notes inbox and main-agent gate, ClusterSpec max_replicas and static with render gating and pins, the agent API with its port, token and pod-IP identity, and migration 0003.

Hive mode: dispatcher leadership authority with epoch fencing, leader-only routing, the activity feed and hive-state notes, advisory file locks, leader in views, stream and UI, the bench arm and API-only kind e2e.
Releases across repos are explicit tasks: any-mcp v0.2.0 tag, claude-code-wrapper 0.2.0 image and tag, the orchestrator pins, the agents-helmfile bump, apply and smoke.

One shared orchestrator any-mcp plugin carries every agent-to-orchestrator tool (leadership, file locks, scale, init-script edit) with a per-cluster scoped credential in the pod; built once here, the other epics add tools to it.
Headless parity: every UI capability has a documented public API and an API-only e2e test.
The leader is the only agent that receives untargeted messages; an explicit target still wins.
The first ready agent leads when a hive starts, at epoch 1.
Leadership and the other agent tools are offered through an any-mcp plugin, not the wrapper's ccw MCP server.
Handover only, no takeovers by agents: only the current leader gives leadership away, to a named or any agent; a stale epoch is rejected.
Feed: file writes, edits and deletes (paths only), Bash commands with exit status cut at 200 chars, finished turns with their first line, leadership changes; no tool outputs, no Read, Grep or Glob.
The feed is delivered through the wrapper notes inbox as hook additionalContext at the next tool result (throttled) and the next prompt.

Tools on load hint the hive mode (no CLAUDE.md fragment); the wrapper notes inbox is enabled only for hived agents; a static single-pod cluster gets no hive, peers or messaging tools: the agent is alone.
No forced handover; advise handing over above auto_compact_pct - 15 and keep every agent's context visible.
The user can make any agent leader from the UI and the API through the same leadership queue; a user request overrides handover-only.
Advisory file locks: agents claim files, a write to a file claimed by another agent is warned, the leader can reassign or discard any lock.
